name: Reconstruction Dynamics Phase Declaration
purpose: Freeze admissible terminology and establish the bounded dynamics phase before introducing evolution or stabilization language.

phase_definition.canonical_statement: The reconstruction dynamics phase permits the formalization of how bounded reconstruction structures evolve, stabilize, and interact as governance-only analog indicators for projection systems.
phase_definition.non_escalation_rule: No reconstruction dynamic or stable state may be treated as ontologically primitive, physical proof, or final closure.

governance_rules.rule: Reconstruction dynamics define evolution of accessibility, not identity or source truth.
All dynamics constructs must maintain NON_PHYSICAL and ANALOG_ONLY status.
Stable states (basins) do not imply truth, equilibrium, or ontology identity.
Conflict preservation is mandatory across all dynamic transformations.
Recursive interaction does not imply self-complete closure or feedback identity.

forbidden_claims: Reality literally evolves according to reconstruction dynamics.
Stability implies truth or ontology identity.
Dynamics alignment eliminates the need for loss accounting.
